observation.command:
cd /workspace && SA=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)
docker compose exec -T -e SA_KEY="$SA" backend sh -c '
  printf "x-super-admin-api-key: %s\nContent-Type: application/json\n" "$SA_KEY" > /tmp/h.txt
  printf "{\"name\":\"Eckener-Schule Flensburg\",\"slug\":\"eckener-schule\"}" > /tmp/school.json
  printf "{\"schoolSlug\":\"eckener-schule\",\"emailAddress\":\"admin@schule.de\",\"role\":\"admin\",\"firstName\":\"Vorname\",\"lastName\":\"Nachname\"}" > /tmp/teacher.json
  echo "--- Create school:"
  wget -qO- --post-file=/tmp/school.json --header-file=/tmp/h.txt http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/school/create-one-school
  echo
  echo "--- Create teacher:"
  wget -qO- --post-file=/tmp/teacher.json --header-file=/tmp/h.txt http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/teacher/create-one-teacher
' 2>&1 | head -40
